<?php
/**
 * Container Orchestration Platform - OAuth Authentication Module
 * Handles OAuth2 redirect flow with RBAC enforcement
 */

namespace ContainerOrch\Auth;

use ContainerOrch\Config\AppConfig;
use ContainerOrch\RBAC\RoleManager;
use ContainerOrch\Session\SecureSession;

class OAuthRedirectHandler
{
    private AppConfig $config;
    private RoleManager $roleManager;
    private SecureSession $session;
    private array $allowedHosts;

    public function __construct(AppConfig $config, RoleManager $roleManager, SecureSession $session)
    {
        $this->config = $config;
        $this->roleManager = $roleManager;
        $this->session = $session;
        $this->allowedHosts = $config->get('oauth.allowed_redirect_hosts', []);
    }

    /**
     * Validates the redirect URI against configured allowed hosts.
     * Uses strict host comparison with scheme enforcement.
     */
    public function validateRedirectUri(string $uri): bool
    {
        if (empty($uri)) {
            return false;
        }

        $parsed = parse_url($uri);
        if ($parsed === false || !isset($parsed['host'])) {
            return false;
        }

        // Enforce HTTPS scheme
        if (!isset($parsed['scheme']) || $parsed['scheme'] !== 'https') {
            return false;
        }

        // Validate against allowed hosts
        $requestHost = $parsed['host'];
        return $this->isHostAllowed($requestHost);
    }

    /**
     * Check if the host matches any allowed host pattern.
     * Supports subdomain wildcards (e.g., *.example.com)
     */
    private function isHostAllowed(string $host): bool
    {
        $host = strtolower(trim($host));

        foreach ($this->allowedHosts as $allowedHost) {
            $allowedHost = strtolower(trim($allowedHost));

            if ($allowedHost === $host) {
                return true;
            }

            // Wildcard subdomain matching
            if (str_starts_with($allowedHost, '*.')) {
                $baseDomain = substr($allowedHost, 2);
                if (str_ends_with($host, $baseDomain)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Process the OAuth callback and redirect to the original destination.
     * Enforces RBAC before allowing redirect to admin endpoints.
     */
    public function handleCallback(array $request): array
    {
        $code = $request['code'] ?? null;
        $state = $request['state'] ?? null;

        if (!$code || !$state) {
            return ['error' => 'Missing OAuth parameters', 'status' => 400];
        }

        // Validate CSRF state token
        $storedState = $this->session->get('oauth_state');
        if (!hash_equals($storedState ?? '', $state)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid state parameter', 'status' => 403];
        }

        // Exchange code for token
        $tokenData = $this->exchangeCodeForToken($code);
        if (!$tokenData) {
            return ['error' => 'Token exchange failed', 'status' => 500];
        }

        // Store user session
        $userInfo = $this->fetchUserInfo($tokenData['access_token']);
        $this->session->set('user', $userInfo);
        $this->session->set('roles', $this->roleManager->getRolesForUser($userInfo['sub']));

        // Retrieve and validate the post-login redirect
        $redirectUri = $this->session->get('post_login_redirect');
        return $this->buildRedirectResponse($redirectUri, $userInfo);
    }

    /**
     * Constructs the redirect response after successful authentication.
     * Applies RBAC checks for protected container management endpoints.
     */
    private function buildRedirectResponse(?string $redirectUri, array $userInfo): array
    {
        $defaultRedirect = '/dashboard';

        if (empty($redirectUri)) {
            return ['redirect' => $defaultRedirect, 'status' => 302];
        }

        // Validate the redirect URI
        if (!$this->validateRedirectUri($redirectUri)) {
            // Fall back: check if it's a relative path (safe internal redirect)
            if ($this->isRelativePath($redirectUri)) {
                return $this->applyRbacToRedirect($redirectUri, $userInfo);
            }
            return ['redirect' => $defaultRedirect, 'status' => 302];
        }

        return ['redirect' => $redirectUri, 'status' => 302];
    }

    /**
     * Determines if a URI is a safe relative path.
     */
    private function isRelativePath(string $uri): bool
    {
        // Must start with / and not contain protocol-relative patterns
        if (!str_starts_with($uri, '/')) {
            return false;
        }

        // Block protocol-relative URLs
        if (str_starts_with($uri, '//')) {
            return false;
        }

        // Ensure no scheme is embedded after normalization
        $decoded = urldecode($uri);
        if (preg_match('#^/+[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9+\-.]*://#', $decoded)) {
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Apply RBAC enforcement for admin/container management paths.
     */
    private function applyRbacToRedirect(string $path, array $userInfo): array
    {
        $protectedPrefixes = ['/admin', '/clusters/manage', '/nodes/deploy'];
        $roles = $this->session->get('roles', []);

        foreach ($protectedPrefixes as $prefix) {
            if (str_starts_with($path, $prefix)) {
                if (!in_array('cluster-admin', $roles) && !in_array('platform-admin', $roles)) {
                    return ['redirect' => '/dashboard', 'status' => 302, 'notice' => 'Insufficient permissions'];
                }
            }
        }

        return ['redirect' => $path, 'status' => 302];
    }

    private function exchangeCodeForToken(string $code): ?array
    {
        $tokenEndpoint = $this->config->get('oauth.token_endpoint');
        $ch = curl_init($tokenEndpoint);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_POST => true,
            CURLOPT_POSTFIELDS => http_build_query([
                'grant_type' => 'authorization_code',
                'code' => $code,
                'client_id' => $this->config->get('oauth.client_id'),
                'client_secret' => $this->config->get('oauth.client_secret'),
                'redirect_uri' => $this->config->get('oauth.callback_url'),
            ]),
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10,
        ]);
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
        return $response ? json_decode($response, true) : null;
    }

    private function fetchUserInfo(string $accessToken): ?array
    {
        $userInfoEndpoint = $this->config->get('oauth.userinfo_endpoint');
        $ch = curl_init($userInfoEndpoint);
        curl_setopt_array($ch, [
            CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER => ['Authorization: Bearer ' . $accessToken],
            CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER => true,
            CURLOPT_TIMEOUT => 10,
        ]);
        $response = curl_exec($ch);
        curl_close($ch);
        return $response ? json_decode($response, true) : null;
    }
}
